info.title: Kahade API
info.description: PT Kawal Hak Dengan Aman — Platform Escrow P2C Indonesia

password.description: Password (min 12 chars, must contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character)

phoneNumber.description: Phone number (E.164 or local Indonesian format, e.g. 08xx)

password.description: Password (min 12 chars, must contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character)

code.description: Six-digit TOTP code or 10–16 character backup code

username.description: Username (can be changed once per month)

currentPassword.description: Current password (required when changing username, phone, or contact info)

avatarKey.description: S3 key of the uploaded avatar

headerKey.description: S3 key of the uploaded header image

mfaCode.description: TOTP code for users with 2FA enabled

evidenceUrls.description: Evidence URLs (must be platform storage URLs)

parentId.description: Parent comment ID for threaded replies

ktpFileKey.description: S3 fileKey from confirmed KTP upload (format: uploads/kyc-ktp/{userId}/{filename})

selfieFileKey.description: S3 fileKey from confirmed selfie upload (format: uploads/kyc-selfie/{userId}/{filename})

purpose.description: Upload purpose determines allowed content types, max file size, and URL expiry duration

fileSize.description: Exact file size in bytes. Must be within the allowed range for the upload purpose.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the uploaded file for integrity verification

refund_amount.description: Cumulative amount refunded by Midtrans, for refund and partial_refund notifications

refund_key.description: Merchant refund reference used to make refund webhook delivery idempotent

method.description: Payment method (KAHADE_WALLET not available for top-up)

cardToken.description: Card token from Midtrans.js tokenization (required for CREDIT_CARD method)

pin.description: Wallet PIN (6 digits) — collected by mobile but not verified for top-up

txId.description: Transaction ID of the pending withdrawal

currentPin.description: Current wallet PIN — required when changing an existing PIN

password.description: Account password — required when changing an existing PIN

role.description: User role for role-based voucher validation

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number; required for PHYSICAL_GOODS only

courierName.description: Courier name; required for PHYSICAL_GOODS only

fileUrls.description: S3 object keys for proof files

proofId.description: Specific submitted delivery proof to review
Specific submitted delivery proof to reject

code.description: Referral code (format: KH followed by 6-8 alphanumeric characters)

fileUrl.description: File URL (must be HTTPS; trusted storage domain enforced at service layer)

thumbnailUrl.description: Thumbnail URL (must be HTTPS; trusted storage domain enforced at service layer)

messageType.description: Message type (TEXT, IMAGE, or FILE). SYSTEM is reserved for internal use.

replyToId.description: ID of the message being replied to

notifIds.description: Array of notification IDs to operate on (max 50 per request)

orderValue.description: Order value in IDR (optional for preview validation)

userRole.description: User role for role-based voucher validation

targetId.description: ID of the user being reported

bankAccountId.description: Bank account ID to withdraw to
Bank account ID to withdraw to

amount.description: Amount in IDR (whole number; will be converted to sen internally)

type.description: CREDIT to add funds, DEBIT to subtract funds

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key to prevent duplicate adjustments (SEC-013)

password.description: Admin password for re-authentication (required to access encrypted KYC documents)

content.description: Message content to send into the dispute order chat

adminId.description: Admin ID to assign. SUPER_ADMIN only. Defaults to self-assignment.

validFrom.description: Valid from date in ISO 8601 format

validUntil.description: Valid until date in ISO 8601 format

resolution.description: Reason or resolution note for the dead-letter event

channels.description: Delivery channels. Push uses registered native FCM tokens.

reason.description: Reason for hiding or unhiding the rating

password.description: Initial password (min 12 chars, must contain uppercase, lowercase, number, special char)

rolloutPercent.description: Staged rollout percentage (0-100). Can only be increased once set.
